				return await this.launchAndConnectToPipes(primaryPipeName, secondaryPipeName);
			}

		async launchAndConnectToPipes(primaryPipeName, secondaryPipeName) {
			try {
				await this.launchClientAndConnect(primaryPipeName);
				try {
					await this.setAccessTokenWithPreviousKnownValue();
				} catch (exSettingPrimaryToken) {
					this.handleError(exSettingPrimaryToken, `Failed to set access token for pipe ${primaryPipeName}, aborting the connection`);
					return false;
				}
			} catch (exOnPrimaryClient) {
				this.handleError(exOnPrimaryClient, `Failed to connect to primary pipe: '${primaryPipeName}', pid: ${this.clientLauncher.getPid()}`);
				await this.clientLauncher.tryKillClientProcess(false);
				try {
					await this.launchClientAndConnect(secondaryPipeName);
					try {
						await this.setAccessTokenWithPreviousKnownValue();
					} catch (exSettingSecondaryToken) {
						this.handleError(exSettingSecondaryToken, `Failed to set access token for pipe ${secondaryPipeName}, aborting the connection`);
						return false;
					}
				} catch (exOnSecondaryClient) {
					this.handleError(exOnSecondaryClient, `Failed to connect to secondary pipe: '${secondaryPipeName}', pid: ${this.clientLauncher.getPid()}`);
					await this.clientLauncher.tryKillClientProcess(false);
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

				}
			}

		}

		/**
		* Check if the user has the right to use a specific entitlement.
		* @param entitlement Entitlement to be checked.
		* @returns Promise value is an object of boolean
		*/
		async checkEntitlement(entitlement) {
			const entitlements = [entitlement];
			const response = await this.checkEntitlements(entitlements);
			return response.entitlements.size > 0 && response.entitlements.has(entitlement);
		}

		* @param entitlementIds Array of entitlement ids to be checked.
		* @param packageEntitlementIds Array of package entitlement ids to be checked.
		* @param includeCustomData Boolean to include custom data, default is false.
		* @returns Promise value is an object of EntitlementDetailsResponse
		*/
		async checkEntitlementDetails(entitlementIds, packageEntitlementIds, includeCustomData = false) {
			logger_1.logger.info(`checkEntitlementDetails: checking entitlements details for:  entitlementIds: ${entitlementIds} , packageEntitlementIds: ${packageEntitlementIds}`);
			const failedMessage = "An unexpected error occurred while trying to check for entitlement details";
			try {
				const response = await this.requestIpc.sendMessage(ipc.EntitlementDetailsResponse, new ipc.EntitlementDetailsRequest({
					entitlementIds,
					packageEntitlementIds,
					includeCustomData
				}));
				if (response.isSuccessful()) logger_1.logger.info("Successfully checked for entitlement details request.");
				else logger_1.logger.warn("A problem occurred while trying to check for entitlement details", response);
				return response;
			} catch (err) {
				throw this.handleError(err, failedMessage);
			}
		}
		/**
		* Check if the user has the right to use a specific package.
		* @param packageEntitlementIds Entitlement to be checked.
		* @returns Promise value is an object of EntitlementDetailsResponse
		*/
		async checkPackageEntitlements(packageEntitlementIds) {
			return await this.checkEntitlementDetails([], packageEntitlementIds);
		}
		/**
		* Releases IPC connection
		* @param timeout in millisecond for ipc disconnection
		* @param killLicensingClient to force kill of the licensing client process if it was launched by this instance of licensingSdk
		*/
		async dispose(timeout = this.defaultDisposeTimeoutMs, killLicensingClient = false) {
			try {
				this.deactivateReconnect = true;
				if (this.reconnectTimeoutHandle) clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimeoutHandle);
				if (this.reconnectNotificationTimeoutHandle) clearTimeout(this.reconnectNotificationTimeoutHandle);
				await this.requestIpc.dispose(timeout);
				if (killLicensingClient) await this.clientLauncher.tryKillClientProcess(true);
			} catch (e) {
				logger_1.logger.error(`An exception occurred while trying to dispose [killLicensingClient: ${killLicensingClient}]`, null, e);
			}
		}
		/**
		* Registers an event listener for license update notifications.
		*
		* This method allows you to subscribe to license update events and be notified
		* when a license update has occurred.
		*
		* @param callback - A callback function that will be called when a license
		*                   update has occurred. The callback will be passed a
		*                   LicenseUpdateNotificationMessage object containing the details
		*                   of the license update.
		*/
		onLicenseUpdate(callback) {
			logger_1.logger.info("Registering callback method for 'onLicenseUpdate' notification");
			this.notificationIpc.on(Events_1.EVENTS.LICENSE_UPDATE_NOTIFICATION, callback);
		}
		/**
		* Registers an event listener for license expired notifications.
		*
		* This method allows you to subscribe to license expired events and be notified
		* when a license has expired.
		*
		* @param callback - A callback function that will be called when a license
		*                   has expired. The callback will be passed a
		*                   LicenseExpiredNotificationMessage object containing the details
		*                   of the expired license.
		*/
		onLicenseExpired(callback) {
			logger_1.logger.info("Registering callback method for 'onLicenseExpired' notification");
			this.notificationIpc.on(Events_1.EVENTS.LICENSE_EXPIRED_NOTIFICATION, callback);
		}
		/**
		* Registers an event listener for borrow feature status notifications.
		*
		* This method allows you to subscribe to borrow feature status events and be notified
		* periodically about the status of the borrow feature.
		*
		* @param callback - A callback function that will be called when a borrow feature
		*                   status event is received. The callback will be passed a
		*                   BorrowFeatureStatusNotificationMessage object containing the result
		*                   of the status check.
		*/
		onBorrowFeatureStatus(callback) {
			logger_1.logger.info("Registering callback method for 'onBorrowFeatureStatus' notification");
			this.notificationIpc.on(Events_1.EVENTS.BORROW_FEATURE_STATUS_NOTIFICATION, callback);
		}
		async launchLicensingClient(pipeName) {
			try {
				await this.clientLauncher.launch(pipeName);
				logger_1.logger.info(`Licensing client process run with pid: ${this.clientLauncher.getPid()}`);
			} catch (e) {
				this.handleError(e, `Failed to launch licensing client: ${e}, pid: ${this.clientLauncher.getPid()}`);
				if (e.message === clientLauncher_1.ClientLauncherErrorType.ClientAlreadyLaunched) {
					if (this.config.useBundledLicensing) throw e;
					return;
				}
				throw e;
			}
		}
		async connectToRequestPipe(pipeName) {
			this.lastHandshakeResponse = await this.requestIpc.connect(pipeName);
			this.connectedPipeName = pipeName;
		}
		async connectToNotificationPipe(pipeName) {
			try {
				await this.notificationIpc.connect(pipeName);
			} catch (e) {
				this.handleError(e, "Failed to connect to licensing client notification channel.");
			}
		}
		async launchClientAndConnect(pipeName) {
			await this.launchLicensingClient(pipeName);
			await this.connectToRequestPipe(pipeName);
		}
		async setAccessTokenWithPreviousKnownValue() {
			if (this.accessToken && this.accessToken.token) {
				logger_1.logger.info("try set access token");
				if (await this.setAccessToken(this.accessToken.token, this.accessToken.expiration)) logger_1.logger.info("access token set");
				else logger_1.logger.info("couldn't set access token");
			}
		}
		handleError(err, message) {
			let sdkError;
			if (err instanceof ipcBase_1.IpcError) sdkError = licensingSdkError_1.LicensingSdkError.FromIpcError(err);
			else if (err instanceof ipc.IpcResponse) sdkError = licensingSdkError_1.LicensingSdkError.FromUnsuccessfulMessage(err);
			else if (err instanceof Error) sdkError = licensingSdkError_1.LicensingSdkError.FromError(err);
			else sdkError = licensingSdkError_1.LicensingSdkError.FromReject(err);
			if (sdkError.errorType) logger_1.logger.warn(`Failed with ipc error type: ${ipcBase_1.LicensingIpcErrorType[sdkError.errorType]}, pid: ${this.clientLauncher.getPid()}`);
			logger_1.logger.error(message, null, sdkError);
			return sdkError;
		}
	};
}));
//#endregion
